section: Migration - types, streams, causes and consequences; internal migration in India
subsections: Migration from AP - Gulf source districts, seasonal labour regions, Telugu diaspora

accepted.s: Which group of districts in Andhra Pradesh is identified as a major source of domestic workers and unskilled labour migrating to the Gulf countries?
o: East Godavari, West Godavari and Krishna
accepted.x: Anantapur, Kadapa and Chittoor in Rayalaseema are identified as important source districts for domestic workers and unskilled labour migrating to the Gulf.
accepted.tq: Use the source-region clue to distinguish Rayalaseema districts from other Andhra Pradesh regions.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf source districts, seasonal labour regions, Telugu diaspora  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding migration from Dr B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema district:
1. About 15,000 workers had gone to GCC countries by December 2025.
2. More than 70 per cent of them were young women.
3. Most of the women worked as housemaids.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The reported migration from Konaseema involved about 15,000 workers, over 70 per cent of whom were young women, mostly employed as housemaids.
accepted.tq: Check the numerical figure, gender share and occupational detail together before selecting the coded option.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf source districts, seasonal labour regions, Telugu diaspora  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Seasonal labour migration from Andhra Pradesh is particularly associated with which of the following areas?
o: The forest districts of southern Telangana
Only the urban districts of Coastal Andhra
accepted.x: Seasonal labour leaves drought-prone Rayalaseema as well as the north-coastal districts of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the paired geographical regions rather than choosing an option narrowed by the word 'only'.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf source districts, seasonal labour regions, Telugu diaspora  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Srikakulam fishermen are specifically reported to migrate seasonally to which destination?
accepted.x: Srikakulam fishermen migrate seasonally to the Gujarat coast.
accepted.tq: Test the migrant-origin and destination pair directly; the location is the key discriminator.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf source districts, seasonal labour regions, Telugu diaspora  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the Gulf countries mentioned as destinations of the Telugu diaspora?
accepted.x: Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain are the Gulf destinations listed. Malaysia is not included in that list.
accepted.tq: Find the option outside the specifically listed group instead of relying on general knowledge about overseas Telugu communities.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf source districts, seasonal labour regions, Telugu diaspora  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Telugu communities are reported to exist in how many countries, while Andhra Pradesh runs NRT networks in how many countries?
accepted.x: Telugu communities exist in 195 countries, while Andhra Pradesh runs Non-Resident Telugu networks in 148 countries.
accepted.tq: Split the paired figures carefully; the larger number refers to the wider community presence and the smaller one to NRT networks.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf source districts, seasonal labour regions, Telugu diaspora  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The help desk for Telugus stranded in the Gulf was run by which organisation?
accepted.x: The AP Non-Resident Telugu Society, or APNRT, ran the help desk for Telugus stranded in the Gulf.
accepted.tq: Use the organisation-function association: diaspora agency and assistance to stranded Telugus.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf source districts, seasonal labour regions, Telugu diaspora  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The IOM's World Migration Report 2026 reconfirmed which position of India?
o: India was the largest source of seasonal labour in Asia
India had the highest urbanisation rate in the world
India was the largest recipient of remittances
India had the lowest migration rate among major economies
accepted.x: The World Migration Report 2026 reconfirmed India as the world's top remittance recipient.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the report's remittance finding from unrelated migration and urbanisation indicators.

accepted.s: Which organisation began the Nationwide Migration Survey in July 2026?
accepted.x: The National Statistical Office began the Nationwide Migration Survey in July 2026.
accepted.tq: Apply the 'who does this job?' method to distinguish the statistical agency from migration and diaspora bodies.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding migration from Konaseema:
1. About 15,000 jobseekers had gone to GCC countries by December 2025.
2. Over 70 per cent of them were women.
3. The migration was exclusively for highly skilled professional employment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the migrants were mostly women working as housemaids, and cases of exploitation were reported.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme occupational claim and retain the supported figure and gender-share statements.

accepted.s: The Chief Minister stated that migration from Uttarandhra would 'become a thing of the past' with the construction of which infrastructure project?
accepted.x: The statement linked the expected reduction in migration from Uttarandhra to the new Bhogapuram airport.
accepted.tq: Match the policy statement with the specific infrastructure project named in it.

accepted.s:
Which of the following problems are associated with migrant workers according to the migration debate?
1. Loss of access to social security
2. Loss of voting opportunities
3. Patchy portability of ONORC and EPF benefits
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three are identified concerns: migrants may miss social security and voting opportunities, while portability through ONORC and EPF remains patchy.
accepted.tq: Treat the three consequences as a connected issue cluster and check whether any statement is incorrectly narrowed.

accepted.s: Approximately how many migrant workers in Andhra Pradesh were reported to be affected by the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls?
accepted.x: About 25 lakh migrant workers in Andhra Pradesh were reported to be affected by the electoral-roll SIR.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the state-level migrant-worker figure from the separate Konaseema migration figure.

accepted.s: Migration is regarded as the main component of the difference between rural and urban growth because:
o: natural increase differs little between rural and urban areas
all rural migrants move only to metropolitan cities
natural increase is absent in rural areas but very high in urban areas
urban areas have no migration-related population increase
accepted.x: Migration is the main component of the rural-urban growth difference because natural increase differs little between rural and urban areas.
accepted.tq: Link the cause with the demographic comparison instead of choosing absolute statements about rural or urban growth.

accepted.s: Which of the following is expected to provide fresh migration data in India?
accepted.x: Census 2027 is expected to produce fresh migration data, alongside the MoSPI Migration Survey for July 2026–June 2027.
accepted.tq: Use the date-specific source of future demographic data to eliminate completed or unrelated sources.

accepted.s: The MoSPI Migration Survey referred to in the context of fresh migration data covers which period?
accepted.x: The MoSPI Migration Survey covers July 2026 to June 2027.
accepted.tq: Read the starting and ending months together; both the year and survey span matter.

accepted.s: India received remittances amounting to approximately how much in 2024, according to the World Migration Report 2026 reference?
accepted.x: India was identified as the largest remittance recipient, receiving approximately USD 137 billion in 2024.
accepted.tq: Use the exact figure rather than confusing it with lower alternative remittance estimates.

accepted.s: Remittances are significant for India because they serve as:
o: a substitute for all domestic tax revenue
the exclusive source of foreign investment
accepted.x: Remittances constitute a major external-sector buffer for India.
accepted.tq: Match the economic function with the correct external-sector concept.

accepted.s: The Supreme Court questioned whether the word 'migration' in the electoral-roll SIR referred to:
o: only rural-to-urban movement within a district
accepted.x: The Supreme Court asked whether the migration ground in the SIR referred to inter-State moves or illegal immigration.
accepted.tq: Separate two closely related interpretations of the same administrative term.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements correctly describes APNRT?
o: It is the organisation conducting the national migration census.
It is the body responsible for electoral-roll revision throughout India.
It is Andhra Pradesh's diaspora agency.
It is the international body publishing the World Migration Report.
accepted.x: APNRT is Andhra Pradesh's diaspora agency and has also operated assistance mechanisms such as the Gulf help desk.
accepted.tq: Identify the institution by its role and avoid assigning it the functions of national statistical or electoral bodies.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. About 15,000 Konaseema workers had gone to GCC countries by December 2025.
B. The Nationwide Migration Survey began in July 2026.
C. The World Migration Report 2026 reconfirmed India's position as the top remittance recipient.
D. The MoSPI Migration Survey period began in July 2026.
accepted.x: The correct sequence is A, C, B, D: December 2025, the 2026 report reference, July 2026 commencement of the NSO survey, and the July 2026 start of the MoSPI survey period.
accepted.tq: Fix the December 2025 event first, then place the 2026 report and the two July 2026 survey references.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: APNRT — Gulf help desk for stranded Telugus
NSO — Telugu diaspora network in 148 countries
accepted.x: APNRT ran the help desk for Telugus stranded in the Gulf. The other organisations have been assigned functions not associated with them in this context.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure organisation-function pair and eliminate swapped institutional roles.
